title: Find Common Characters
statement: You are given an array of strings `words`. Collect every character that appears in each one of the strings, counting repeats: a letter belongs in the result as many times as the smallest number of times it occurs in any single string of `words`. Return these characters as a list of one-letter strings, in any order (return an empty list when no letter is shared by all strings).
constraints: words[i] contains only lowercase English letters
notes:
## Intuition

A letter can appear in the answer only as often as the word that has the fewest copies of it allows. So the whole problem is a per-letter minimum over the words. One could also take each letter of the first word and cross off a matching copy in every other word, but that repeated searching is slower; counting with 26 slots is direct.

## Approach

1. Start `minCount` with `Infinity` for all 26 letters: nothing has limited them yet.
2. For each `word`, build `count`, how many times each letter occurs in it.
3. Lower each `minCount[c]` to `count[c]` when the word has fewer copies.
4. After all words, emit letter `c` exactly `minCount[c]` times into `result`.

## Example 1, step by step

`words = ["bella", "label", "roller"]`. After `"bella"`: `a = 1, b = 1, e = 1, l = 2`, all other letters `0`. `"label"` has the same counts, so nothing changes. `"roller"` has `e = 1, l = 2` but no `a` or `b`, so those drop to `0`. The remaining minimums are `e = 1` and `l = 2`, giving `["e", "l", "l"]`.

## Complexity

- Time: O(total length of words + 26 · words.length): each character is counted once and each word does one 26-letter merge.
- Space: O(1) besides the output: two arrays of 26 counters.

## Pitfalls

- Keep duplicates: a letter shared twice by every word appears twice in the answer.
- Initialise the minimums to `Infinity` (or to the first word's counts), not `0`, or every letter vanishes.
- A letter missing from even one word must drop to `0`; the 26-slot `count` makes that automatic.

## Variables

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `minCount` | for each letter, the fewest times it occurs in any word seen so far |
| `word` | the word being counted |
| `count` | letter counts of the current word |
| `c` | letter index, `0` for `a` up to `25` for `z` |
| `result` | the shared letters, repeated by their minimum counts |

narration.2: No word has limited any letter yet, so every letter starts with an unlimited count.
narration.4: Process the words one at a time.
narration.5: Fresh counters for the 26 letters of this word.
narration.7: Count this character in the slot for its letter.
narration.9: Merge this word into the running minimums, letter by letter.
narration.10: A letter can be shared only as often as this word contains it.
narration.15: Walk through the letters from a to z.
narration.16: Repeat the letter as many times as every word can supply it.
narration.17: Add one copy of the letter to the answer.
narration.20: Return the shared letters with their repeats.
